name: hirestarship-website
description: hirestarship.com — static site, no build step. devDependencies exist only for scripts/prerender.mjs (run by CI).

scripts.build: rm -rf _site && rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude .github --exclude .claude --exclude node_modules --exclude _site --exclude scripts --exclude 'package*.json' --exclude CLAUDE.md --exclude README.md --exclude .gitignore --exclude .DS_Store ./ _site/ && node scripts/prerender.mjs --out _site/index.html
